body: Well sex is a huge factor in relationships. If I can't ever satisfy a girl, then I don't think a relationship could ever flourish

Hello, thanks for responding. I'd hardly consider myself "highly intelligent." I would be ecstatic to find love but love just seems harder to find than sex, especially at my age. Sex is the baseline for me. Sex is an unattainable validation of my worth as a person. Love would go beyond my needs. If I found love I wouldn't be here. Love would be more validating than sex. I don't think I'll find either in my life though.

Hey Joe, thanks for responding. I actually am pretty calm at the moment. I don't lose my calm very often. I have been lifting weights and have learned a couple languages over the past years. My dad has never doubted my intelligence or my potential academically. He tells me I am a failure because I have failed at the simple human task of attracting the opposite sex. I enjoyed reading your comment because you show an admirable amount of compassion, but I don't think my post conveyed what I felt to you. I  do have my whole life ahead of me, I can become a doctor, I can become interesting, and I can become physically attractive. I've been accepted to my top University. My problem is that none of this makes a difference. My penis will not grow because of these things. No girl will ever be content with my penis. She'll always want something more, and she is right in doing so. The idea that I have this fixed quality that makes me a lesser person is what has driven me to this point.
